QUOTE: "**Drain-then-dispatch.** `HealthMonitor::process_events` swaps the event queue out under `event_mutex_`, then invokes callbacks with the lock released. The callbacks run on the engine thread, not the monitor thread (`health_monitor.cpp:118`)."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that events are queued under a mutex and drained by the caller's (engine) thread, so callbacks do not run on the monitor thread.
